workflow: Organization invitation preview, create, revoke and accept

authorization.preview: Only pending unexpired 128-bit invitation capability; active organization and currently authorized inviter; no anonymous table reads or private schema usage granted
authorization.creation: Verified mapped owner/admin or platform administrator; owners/platform admins required for owner invites; validated same-organization active position, manager and location
authorization.acceptance: Confirmed active non-anonymous native account with exact stored invitation email; invitation locked and current inviter authority rechecked
authorization.enrollment: Creates a new source identity mapping only without a historical email/UUID/mapping collision; confirmed native email and authorized invite approve the membership
authorization.existing_members: Active memberships retain role/position/manager/store. Suspended or removed memberships require review.
authorization.manager_assignment: Invite manager source-user ID converted to organization membership ID
